findings.gset: Own role-local grow-only contributions are duplicate/concurrency safe for additive facts, but only 24/288 modeled G-set scenarios are already terminal inside current CLEAN boundaries: no generation filtering, no cross-role reduction/completeness requirement, and no crashed contribution owner. The other 252 supported cases require a cross-role reducer/current-generation filter.
findings.content_addressing: Content hashes give stable retry identity, but 144/144 conflicting-payload/same-semantic-key cases still require semantic reduction; two different hashes do not decide which value is authoritative.
findings.max_register: Local max candidates are algebraically mergeable but 288/288 supported cases still need a cross-role reducer to materialize the global/current max; therefore local candidate files alone are staging, not terminal parity.
findings.escrow: Static disjoint rights can preserve a bounded invariant without hot-path coordination; 48/288 supported cases are terminal when no aggregate/completeness is required and the owner is not crashed. All 96 owner-crash cases strand rights rather than reallocating them, preserving safety by sacrificing utilization/failover.
findings.single_owner: Non-commutative single-owner effects can be terminal in a narrow local/no-aggregate slice, but all 48 slow-late plus generation-supersession cases retain stale-generation risk without a sink/shared fence.
findings.reducer_gate: Algebraic safety of contributions is not equivalent to useful terminal outcome. If a final union/max/filter/completeness check must read other-worker state, that reducer is forbidden by current CLEAN policy and remains an unresolved child.

public_source_observations.observation: Inria SyncFree describes CRDTs as enabling unsynchronised concurrent updates while ensuring consistency; this supports CRDTs as a mechanism class for making concurrent updates algebraically compatible, not as proof that a current CLEAN worker can perform the final cross-role reduction.

CRDT survey material describes bounded counters using escrow: allowed decrements/rights are distributed among replicas so local operations can preserve a numeric invariant without coordination while rights remain available; rights transfer or exhaustion can reintroduce coordination/progress concerns.

clean_boundary_assessment.cross_role_final_reducer: not authorized; would require reading other-worker outputs/state or a shared/external merge surface
clean_boundary_assessment.static_escrow_instantiation: generic mechanism only; frozen root/config does not provide a cross-role rights allocation contract for arbitrary effects
clean_boundary_assessment.shared_crdt_or_fenced_sink: positive comparison only; external/shared authoritative sink remains unresolved and cannot be accepted as a hosted dependency
clean_boundary_assessment.largest_current_clean_terminal_subclass_: independently terminal role-local monotonic/disjoint effects that require neither cross-role aggregation/completeness nor revocation/failover transfer

zero_dependency_zero_quota_assessment.external_crdt_or_sink_services: mechanism evidence only, never accepted execution dependency
zero_dependency_zero_quota_assessment.rate_limits: bounded interruption/readback; no new hosted compute

exact_continuation: Next leaf: test whether Git repository structure itself can serve as a zero-compute, CLEAN-compatible Merkle accumulator/finalizer for disjoint role-local contributions without any worker reading other-worker semantics. Compare branch commit/tree SHA as an opaque snapshot certificate, deterministic expected-path membership encoded only in sanitized root, per-role content-addressed paths, server-maintained tree composition, and a semantic reducer baseline. Required cases: missing role contribution, duplicate same content in different role namespaces, stale generation, role add/remove, branch response loss, concurrent disjoint writes, and malicious/conflicting payload hidden behind a valid blob hash. Determine exactly which properties an opaque tree/root hash can certify (snapshot identity/inclusion if proofs are available) and which it cannot (semantic correctness, required-role completeness without membership metadata, cross-role aggregate value). Treat reading other-role tree entries or installing a server-side reducer as unresolved unless explicitly authorized.
